action.title: What to do
action.description: where: the host's address and the graphics it serves. status: what a placement is showing, or all of them. load: put a graphic and its words into a placement. update: new words, no animation. play: the next step, or the step named. stop: off. forget: drop a placement whose item was removed.

instance.title: Placement
instance.description: The source id of the graphic placement, which scene.get gives you. Not needed for where, nor for status when you want all of them.

graphic.title: Graphic
graphic.description: The plugin qualified id of the template. Needed by load.

values.title: Values
values.description: The graphic's own fields, by name. Read them from the graphic's schema with scene.item.schema.

step.title: Step
step.description: Which step to play. Left out, play moves to the next one. The graphic's stepCount says how many there are.
